High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior

sentences.text:
1. This is the first application preferred by the applicant under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. wherein he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.173/2022 registered at Police Station City Kotwali District Bhind for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 34 of IPC.
2. It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that he has been falsely implicated in the case and in fact he was the person with whom its employer/complainant did not raise any dispute and for last two years he is performing his duties regularly.

sentences.text: No role is attributable to the applicant except that he had information about some transactions going on.
Confinement would bring social disrepute and personal inconvenience to him.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record and he is peaceful citizen of the locality.
He undertakes to cooperate in the investigation/trial and keep himself available as and when required.
He would not be source of embarrassment and harassment in any manner to the complainant party and would not move in their vicinity.
Thus, prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of anticipatory bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and case diary perused.
5.
Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, but without expressing opinion on merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of Investigating Officer/Investigating Agency.

6. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
i.

The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused;
v. The applicant shall not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and vi.
The applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.

7. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
8. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
